faqSection.description: Find answers to the most common questions about our laundry and dry cleaning services.

badges.title: Clean & Green
badges.subtitle: Better for you, better for planet

leftColumnFaqs.question: Are Your Cleaning Products Eco-Friendly?
leftColumnFaqs.answer: Yes! We use eco-friendly, non-toxic, and biodegradable cleaning products that are safe for your clothes, your family, and the environment. Our priority is to deliver outstanding cleaning results while keeping our planet clean and green.

leftColumnFaqs.question: What To Do When The Cleaners Arrive?
leftColumnFaqs.answer: Simply have your laundry separated into bags if you prefer special handling (e.g., dry clean vs. wash & fold). Our executive will verify the count and provide you an instant digital confirmation.

leftColumnFaqs.question: How Much Will It Cost To Clean My House?
leftColumnFaqs.answer: Our home and upholstery cleaning charges are based on the square footage and specific items selected. You can check our transparent pricing table or request a customized estimate.

leftColumnFaqs.question: Do You Offer Same-Day Service?
leftColumnFaqs.answer: Yes, we offer express and same-day delivery options for select services and pin codes when booked before 10:00 AM.

leftColumnFaqs.question: What Types of Fabrics Do You Clean?
leftColumnFaqs.answer: We cater to cotton, wool, silk, denim, polyester, delicate designer garments, wedding attire, curtains, and heavy bedding.

leftColumnFaqs.question: Is There a Minimum Order Requirement?
leftColumnFaqs.answer: There is a nominal minimum order value of ₹199 for free doorstep pickup and drop delivery.

leftColumnFaqs.question: Is There a Minimum Order Requirement?
leftColumnFaqs.answer: There is a nominal minimum order value of ₹199 for free doorstep pickup and drop delivery.

rightColumnFaqs.question: How Do I Schedule a Pickup and Delivery?
rightColumnFaqs.answer: You can schedule directly via our website booking form, mobile application, or by calling our customer care number.

rightColumnFaqs.question: Do You Offer Stain Removal Services?
rightColumnFaqs.answer: Yes, we specialize in spot treatment and fabric-safe advanced stain removal techniques for stubborn oil, grease, coffee, and wine stains.

rightColumnFaqs.question: Can I Track My Order?
rightColumnFaqs.answer: Yes, live real-time SMS and dashboard tracking are provided from pickup through washing, ironing, and final delivery.

rightColumnFaqs.question: What Are Your Operating Hours?
rightColumnFaqs.answer: Our collection and delivery windows run from 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM, 7 days a week including public holidays.

rightColumnFaqs.question: Do You Clean Household Items Like Curtains and Bedsheets?
rightColumnFaqs.answer: Absolutely! We clean comforters, quilts, duvets, heavy window curtains, cushion covers, and sofa slipcovers.

rightColumnFaqs.question: What Payment Methods Do You Accept?
rightColumnFaqs.answer: We accept UPI, Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, all major Credit/Debit Cards, Net Banking, and Cash on Delivery.

rightColumnFaqs.question: Is My Clothing Insured?
rightColumnFaqs.answer: Yes, all garments under our care are covered against loss or damage under our transparent garment protection policy.

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.content: We may collect personal information such as your name, phone number, email address, service address and any other details you provide while booking a service, making an enquiry or contacting us. We also collect information automatically through our website, such as your IP address, browser type, device information and pages you visit. This information helps us improve your experience and provide better services.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
sections.content: The information we collect is used to provide and improve our laundry and dry cleaning services, process your bookings, respond to your enquiries, communicate with you about your orders, offers or updates, and enhance your overall experience with FreshFold. We may also use your information to analyze website usage and improve our services.

sections.title: Data Security
sections.content: We take appropriate security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, misuse or disclosure. Your data is stored securely and accessed only by authorized personnel. We use industry-standard security practices to ensure your information remains safe.

sections.title: Sharing Your Information
sections.content: We do not sell, rent or trade your personal information. We may share your information only with trusted service providers who assist us in operating our website, processing bookings, delivering our services and improving customer support. These partners are bound to keep your information confidential. We may also disclose information if required by law or to protect our rights, property or safety.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.content: Our website may use cookies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze website traffic and personalize content. Cookies help us understand how you use our website and allow us to improve functionality. You can choose to disable cookies through your browser settings, but this may affect certain features of our website.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to access, update or request the deletion of your personal information. If you have any concerns or requests regarding your data, please contact us using the details provided at the end of this policy. We will make reasonable efforts to respond to your request in a timely manner.

sections.title: Third-Party Links
sections.content: Our website may contain links to third-party websites for your convenience. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these websites. We encourage you to review their privacy policies before providing any personal information.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date. We encourage you to review this page periodically to stay informed.
